lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: Thanks for making time today, Sam. Before we dive in, I've got my colleague Chris from our solutions team here too.

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Great, good to meet you both. We're excited to learn more.

lines.speaker: Chris Doyle
lines.text: Likewise. I'll mostly be listening in today and can jump in on the technical side if needed.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: Perfect. Sam, can you tell us a bit about what's driving you to look for a new solution right now?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Sure. Our dispatch team is spending way too much time manually tracking shipments across three different spreadsheets. It's error prone and it doesn't scale.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: That's a common pain point we hear. How many shipments are you tracking on a typical week?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Somewhere around four hundred, and that number's been growing about fifteen percent quarter over quarter.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: Got it. And who else is involved in evaluating a new platform besides you?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Our ops director, Maria, will need to sign off, and our IT lead will want to review the integration requirements.

lines.speaker: Chris Doyle
lines.text: On the integration side, we support a direct API connection as well as a few pre-built connectors for common ERP systems. What are you currently running?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: We're on NetSuite for the ERP piece.

lines.speaker: Chris Doyle
lines.text: Good news, we have a native NetSuite connector already, so that shouldn't be a blocker.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: And in terms of timeline, is there a specific date you're working backward from?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Ideally we'd want something live before peak season starts in November, so we're hoping to make a decision within the next three to four weeks.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: That's workable on our end. What would you say is the single biggest risk if this doesn't get solved before November?

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Honestly, missed shipments during our busiest stretch, which directly hits customer trust and renewal rates.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: That's really helpful context. Here's what I'd suggest as next steps: Chris will put together a short technical scoping doc based on the NetSuite integration, and I'll get you a proposal reflecting the November timeline.

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: That works. Can you also loop in Maria on the proposal email so she has visibility early?

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: Absolutely, send over her email and I'll include her directly.

lines.speaker: Chris Doyle
lines.text: I'll have the scoping doc over by Wednesday at the latest.

lines.speaker: Sam Whitfield
lines.text: Perfect, thank you both, this was really helpful.

lines.speaker: Jordan Blake
lines.text: Thanks Sam, talk soon.
